name: so101_vial_to_rack_mujoco_v0
description: MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 vial-to-rack benchmark with fixed vial and slot eval cases.
notes: Uses MuJoCo Menagerie robotstudio_so101/so101.xml when available and a primitive SO-101 fallback for minimal smoke installs.
The achieved goal is the vial center suspended in the rack slot; success requires center tolerance, uprightness, and rack-height tolerance.
